mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, email, created_at, updated_at FROM user
SELECT id, username, password, email, created_at, updated_at FROM user -- 一个变量时，括弧里面的内容随便写，赋什么就是什么 WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, password, email, created_at, updated_at FROM user -- keyword 参数在此处被替换为 JDBC 预编译占位符（见运行日志的 Preparing/Parameters 行） WHERE username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT id, username, password, email, created_at, updated_at FROM user ORDER BY id LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(id) AS totalId, MAX(id) AS maxId FROM user
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password, email) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email})
